title: clearance's proofs reach no other device: the in-process real-host seam proof retires
intention: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_asks_the_real_host.py imports cairn.devices.system_rackmount.rackmount to put the real host device behind clear(resources=...); system_rackmount is racked nowhere and publishes no tool, so it has no public interface to reach. The proof retires with its validation; clearance's proofs import nothing from another device.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-encapsulation-holds naming cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_asks_the_real_host.py:66 importing cairn.devices.system_rackmount.rackmount. RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only that component; system_rackmount has no public interface (not racked, no published tool), and outline 6.6.3.2 says the host reading is reached by subscription to Recovery.
how: git rm cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_asks_the_real_host.py; its validation leaves through bin/cairn artifact remove; the forwarding order in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_berths_in_codemother.py names the retired proof so tooth (1) requires it absent at both berths; new proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_proofs_reach_no_other_device.py asks the encapsulation_holds sieve for clearance and checks the retired proof and its validation are gone. No production code.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds sieve returns [] for clearance at cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance: no clearance proof imports another device's code

cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearance_asks_the_real_host.py and cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/validations/test_clearance_asks_the_real_host.json stand nowhere, and the berths proof's forwarding order names the retired proof so its tooth (1) requires it absent at both berths

decisions.text: D1: retire, never rewrite: the real-host seam has no live caller and no public interface to reach; the gate side stays proven by test_clearance.py and the device side by system_rackmount's own proofs.
